sentences.en: "I suppose she has some good qualities," conceded Mr. Harrison grudgingly.
sentences.zh: 哈里森先生不情愿地承认：“我想她确实有一些优点。”

sentences.en: They concede most of their goals from set pieces.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数进球都是来自定位球。

sentences.en: We must concede that we committed an error.
sentences.zh: 我们必须承认我们犯了一个错误。

senses.zh: (不情愿地)承认；承认…为真(或正确)；承认失败

mnemonic: 词根记忆：con+cede（割让）→让出去→让步
